summary: Closed a small apply-path question and enriched an existing entry. A cluster with more committed entries than one batch cannot be left half-applied: the node's pushed batch records its last index, and when the update reports more committed entries remain the engine re-arms the cluster's step worker, so the backlog drains over successive iterations. Recorded that behavior, registered the explained negative, and extended the rebuild behavior entry's executions to cite both the supplied-record receipt and the membership-built one. No execution requested.
